title: Measure enabling turn-gated Engram control from TermAl (Verify/Save) with real timings on a disposable store, as evidence for Engram w-67775bc92f06
outcome: Measure enabling turn-gated Engram control from TermAl (Verify/Save) with real timings on a disposable store, as evidence for Engram w-67775bc92f06
acceptance: On a disposable Engram store and disposable TermAl sessions (never live operator data), a real timed Verify and Save of turn-gated control is recorded at 1, 8 and 32 sessions, with per-phase timings (Verify ~src/session_crud.rs:1789; Save ~:1958 via the adapter ~:234-245, including the serial fresh_targets loop ~:3166-3183 before the fence release), followed by a persisted reload and a new session showing the setting held.
The measurements and their limits are recorded on this item and handed to Engram w-67775bc92f06; no product change is required by this item.
